name: Rage
description: Bonus action: start a rage. The perks below apply only while you are out of heavy armor. You get advantage on Strength checks and saves, extra damage (the Rage Damage bonus) on melee weapon attacks made with Strength, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.
No casting spells and no concentrating on them while raging.

A rage lasts 1 minute. It stops sooner if you are knocked out, or if your turn ends having neither attacked a hostile creature nor taken damage since your previous turn. You may also drop it with a bonus action.

name: Reckless Attack
trigger: Your first attack on your turn
description: On the first attack of your turn you may go reckless. Your Strength melee weapon attacks have advantage until the turn ends.
In return, enemies have advantage on their attacks against you until your next turn starts.

name: Relentless Rage
trigger: You drop to 0 hit points while raging
uses: DC 10, +5 each use until a short or long rest
description: Dropping to 0 HP while raging (without being killed outright) lets you roll a Constitution save at DC 10. Succeed and you stay up with 1 HP.
Every later use adds 5 to the DC. A short or long rest resets it to 10.

name: Frenzy
description: Opt into frenzy as you start a rage. For its whole length, each later turn lets you spend a bonus action on 1 melee weapon attack.
When the rage ends, you take 1 level of exhaustion.

name: Intimidating Presence
description: Target one creature within 30 ft that can see or hear you. It makes a Wisdom save against DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier, or becomes frightened of you, lasting through your next turn.
Spend your action on later turns to extend the fear another round. It stops if the target loses line of sight to you or ends a turn over 60 ft away.
A target that passes the save is immune to this for 24 hours.

name: Retaliation
trigger: You take damage from a creature within 5 ft
description: When a creature within 5 ft damages you, make 1 melee weapon attack against it as a reaction.

name: Spirit Seeker
description: You can cast beast sense and speak with animals, but only as rituals (they take extra time and use no spell slot).

name: Totem Spirit
description: Pick a totem animal when you take this path. Its effect works only while you rage.
Bear: resistance to every damage type except psychic.
Eagle: while you wear no heavy armor, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage, and you can Dash as a bonus action.
Wolf: allies have advantage on melee attacks against any enemy within 5 ft of you.

name: Spirit Walker
description: You can cast commune with nature as a ritual. A spirit version of one of your totem animals appears to deliver the answers.

name: Totemic Attunement
description: Pick a totem animal again (the same one or a new one). Its effect works only while you rage.
Bear: hostile creatures within 5 ft of you attack at disadvantage unless they target you or an ally with this same feature. Enemies that cannot see or hear you, or cannot be frightened, are immune.
Eagle: you fly at a speed matching your current walking speed, but only in short bursts. Land before your turn ends or you drop.
Wolf (bonus action): after a melee weapon hit on a target no bigger than Large, spend a bonus action to topple it prone.

name: Bear
description: While you rage, you resist every damage type except psychic. The bear spirit lets you shrug off nearly any punishment.

name: Eagle
description: During a rage without heavy armor on, Dash costs you only a bonus action on your turn, and any opportunity attack made at you rolls with disadvantage.

name: Wolf
description: While you rage, allies who attack in melee get advantage against any enemy standing within 5 feet of you. You lead the pack.

name: Bear
description: Bear might: your carrying capacity, maximum load and maximum lift all double. You also roll Strength checks to push, pull, lift or break objects with advantage.

name: Eagle
description: You see like an eagle: distance up to 1 mile is clear to you, and within 100 feet you can pick out fine details. Dim light no longer penalizes your Wisdom (Perception) checks.

name: Wolf
description: You get a wolf's hunting senses. You can track creatures while moving at a fast pace, and you can sneak at a normal pace while traveling.

name: Bear
description: While you rage, enemies within 5 feet of you have disadvantage when attacking anyone besides you or an ally with this feature. Enemies that cannot see or hear you, or cannot be frightened, ignore this.

name: Eagle
description: While you rage, you gain a flying speed matching your current walking speed. It lasts only in short bursts: you fall if your turn ends while you are airborne with nothing holding you up.

name: Wolf
trigger: Raging, after a melee weapon hit
description: A rage-only takedown: once your melee weapon attack connects with a Large or smaller creature, a bonus action that same turn drops it prone.

name: Magic Awareness
description: Action: until your next turn ends, you sense where every spell and magic item within 60 ft of you is, unless it has total cover. For each spell sensed you also learn its school.

name: Wild Surge
description: Each time you start a rage, roll a d8 on the Wild Magic table for the effect you get. Where an effect calls for a save, its DC is 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.
1: Every creature you choose that you can see within 30 ft makes a Constitution save or takes 1d12 necrotic damage. You gain 1d12 temporary hit points.
2: Teleport into an unoccupied space you can see, up to 30 ft away. Until the rage ends, you can repeat this with a bonus action on each of your turns.

3: An intangible spirit (in the shape of a flumph or pixie, your pick) appears within 5 ft of a creature you can see within 30 ft. As the turn ends it bursts, and each creature within 5 ft of it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 force damage. Until the rage ends, a bonus action on each of your turns calls up a new one.

4: A weapon you hold deals force damage until the rage ends and gains the light and thrown properties (normal range 20 ft, long range 60 ft). If it leaves your hand, it is back in it as the turn ends.
5: Until the rage ends, any creature that hits you with an attack roll takes 1d6 force damage.
6: Until the rage ends, glowing lights give you +1 AC, and allies within 10 ft of you get the same bonus.
7: Until the rage ends, your enemies treat the ground within 15 ft of you as difficult terrain.

8: Light blasts from you at a creature you choose that you can see within 30 ft: it makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 radiant damage and is blinded until your next turn starts. Until the rage ends, you can repeat this with a bonus action on each of your turns.

name: Bolstering Magic
description: Action: touch a creature (it can be you) and give it one of these benefits:
• For 10 minutes, it adds a d3 to every attack roll and ability check it makes.
• It rolls a d3 and recovers one spent spell slot of that level or lower (its pick). A creature that gets this benefit can't get it again until it finishes a long rest.

name: Unstable Backlash
trigger: You are raging and take damage or fail a save
description: Right after it happens, you can spend your reaction on a fresh Wild Magic roll. Its effect happens at once and replaces the one you had.

name: Controlled Surge
trigger: You roll on the Wild Magic table
description: Roll the die twice and pick which of the two effects happens. If both dice show the same number, ignore it and choose any effect on the table.

name: Elemental Cleaver
description: As a rage starts, infuse one weapon you hold with acid, cold, fire, thunder or lightning (your pick). While you wield it during the rage, its damage becomes that type, each hit adds 1d6 damage of that type, and it becomes a thrown weapon (normal range 20 ft, long range 60 ft). Thrown, it returns to your hand right after it hits or misses. Its benefits stop working while anyone else wields it.
While raging and holding it, you can switch it to another of those damage types with a bonus action.
Level 14 (Demiurgic Colossus): the extra damage becomes 2d6.

name: Mighty Impel
description: Bonus action: grab a creature no bigger than Medium that is within your reach and hurl it into an unoccupied space you can see, up to 30 ft from you. If it is unwilling, it makes a Strength save (DC 8 + your Strength modifier + your proficiency bonus) and stays put on a success.
If it lands with no surface or liquid beneath it that can hold it, it drops, takes falling damage as usual and ends up prone.
Level 14 (Demiurgic Colossus): it works on Large or smaller creatures. Your rages also add 10 ft to your reach and can make you Large or Huge (your pick).

name: Druidcraft
description: Take druidcraft as your Giant's Power cantrip, with Wisdom as its spellcasting ability. The same feature also teaches you Giant (or another language, if you already know Giant).

name: Thaumaturgy
description: Take thaumaturgy as your Giant's Power cantrip, with Wisdom as its spellcasting ability. The same feature also teaches you Giant (or another language, if you already know Giant).
